purpose: Requirements closed as far as the artifacts of their own gate allow, each naming the gate or slice that completes them. tools/partial_closures.py fails the build on an entry with no completer, an unknown completer, or a completer that has landed while the entry is still open.

partial_closures.why: The preview names line prices, modifiers, tax, fees and discounts. Tax resolves to config.configuration_version under category 'tax' and a discount to config.policy under category 'discount'; both are configured, non-zero and exercised. A FEE has no configuration heading before FR-CFG-001C, so ordering.charge_rule can hold one and nothing at this gate creates one. The total is a sum over the components that exist and carries no zero literal for the absent kind.
Whether a discount applies before or after tax is a bill-calculation decision. At M3-A both are computed on the line subtotal, which is the only reading that does not pre-empt FR-BIL-005.
Item, modifier, discount, tax and total snapshots persist at acceptance with the locale. The fee snapshot persists the moment a fee component exists, and no configured source produces one before M4.

A draft cart creates no order, no ledger event and no charge component, and a cart with an order against it is frozen. That a draft creates no FINANCIAL obligation is re-proved once checks and payments exist; the requirements register already dual-gates this row at M4.

Availability, hours, channel and quantity are revalidated at submission. Capacity is the fifth dimension the requirement names and it means station workload, which needs the stations and their thresholds that FR-FUL-013 builds at M3-B.
Add-on orders in one session are distinct aggregates with independent timestamps and independent ledgers, which is proved here. That their FULFILLMENT is independent needs tickets, which are M3-B.

Amendment emits an explicit event retaining before and after, and the window is enforced from the ordering policy. The policy can only speak in commercial states at this gate: 'after preparation has begun' is a ticket state and tickets are M3-B.

partial_closures.aspect: payment dimension of the cancellation policy
partial_closures.why: Cancellation resolves by state, channel and reason. The payment dimension needs payments to exist; the requirements register already dual-gates this row at M4.

An authorized void after acceptance records its reason and an immutable audit row. 'For an unpaid order' cannot be falsified at M3-A because no payment artifact exists to make it false, so the precondition is asserted against an empty set and must be re-proved at M4.
The timeline renders order events chronologically with the audience decided when each entry is written. Station events belong on it and do not exist until M3-B.
Service-request events belong on the same timeline and do not exist until M3-C.

The chain links four of the six artifacts the requirement names — request, cart, table session and order — and survives projection rebuild. 'fulfillment_ticket' is a label of ordering.artifact_kind with no rows until M3-B, so the later slice extends the chain rather than reshaping it.
'service_request' is likewise a label with no rows until M3-C.

partial_closures.aspect: service requests consolidated by a merge
partial_closures.why: A merge consolidates orders, participants, carts and allergy concerns, each move audited and counted. Service requests are the other thing the requirement says must be consolidated and they do not exist until M3-C.

partial_closures.aspect: service requests preserved by a move
partial_closures.why: A move preserves session identity and every order, which is proved by inventory. Service requests are named by the requirement and do not exist until M3-C.

A session cannot close over an unresolved order unless an authorized exception is recorded with a reason and an account. The FINANCIAL condition cannot be proved before checks and settlement exist; the requirements register already dual-gates this row at M4.

Order projections rebuild from the ledger and compare byte-deterministically. Financial projections arrive at M4 and rebuild after outage replay at M5a; the requirements register dual-gates this row at both.
